title: ChatServer model providers
description: Non-secret provider and model settings in models.json. API keys belong in the OS credential manager or an environment override.

$schema.description: Location of this JSON schema for editor validation and completion.

version.description: File format version. Defaults to 1 when omitted.

providers.description: Provider names must be unique. The application checks name uniqueness and config.json model references at runtime.

provider.description: Provider name, also used as its credential-manager account and the prefix of <provider>/<model id> references.

baseUrl.description: Required Responses-compatible API base URL, without a trailing /responses. There is no default.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for this provider's model requests. For repliers with tools, also caps the complete model/tool cycle.

models.description: Models offered by this provider. Model names must be unique within the provider.

id.description: Model ID sent to the API and used after the first slash in config.json model references.

name.description: CLI display/lookup name. Defaults to id when omitted.
